findings.title: A scientific child survives its worker's death and keeps computing after the job is marked interrupted
findings.minimal_input: hero-v2 baseline on main 9cc90e0; scientific child held inside the adapter by the harness barrier (after setsid and limits); SIGKILL the worker process group
findings.command: python3.11 evaluation/cli.py run --lane offline_real_science --subject http-launch --diagnostic science_barrier --results evaluation/results/previews/x --only RS-CANCEL-RESTART
findings.expected: no scientific computation outlives its job: the child detects parent death and ends its session, or recovery kills sessions recorded at dispatch
findings.observed: child pid alive 1 s after the worker was killed and still alive after worker --recover marked the run interrupted; only the harness teardown removed it. API cancellation of a running job does kill the child (passes).

evidence.context: packages/groundwork_adapter/docs/BRIDGE.md requires the launching parent to kill the session before its own exit; a SIGKILLed parent cannot
evidence.suggested_seam: parent-death watchdog in science._child (poll os.getppid() or pipe EOF, then killpg own session), plus persisting the child pgid so worker --recover can kill leftovers

findings.title: One-command launch fails on the team Mac: iCloud Drive hides the dot-named .venv, CPython skips its editable .pth, so bean_api cannot be imported (doctor still reports the backend ready)
findings.minimal_input: checkout under ~/Documents on a Mac with iCloud Drive Desktop & Documents sync (an iCloud Drive File Provider domain); .venv created by `uv sync --locked`
findings.command: DRBEAN_VAR_DIR=<isolated> python3 scripts/dev/launcher.py setup (then start); harness: python3.11 evaluation/cli.py run --lane offline_real_science --subject http-owner4-launcher --results evaluation/results/owner4-launcher
findings.expected: setup finishes (local auth created); start serves API, worker and web; the doctor's 'backend runtime ok' implies the service entry points can import bean_api

Cause verified on this host: within about 6 s of creation the iCloud Drive File Provider sets UF_HIDDEN recursively on dot-named directories under ~/Documents (the same probe in /private/tmp stays visible), and CPython 3.11.17 and 3.13.18 `site` skip hidden .pth files (probe: visible .pth importable, hidden .pth not), so `_editable_impl_dr_bean_backend.pth` is ignored. With apps/api added to PYTHONPATH (what Owner 2's documented commands do via --app-dir/PYTHONPATH and what the harness launch path does) the same unmodified launcher starts in under a second; readiness then distinguishes API, worker and science, and the product processes receive no provider credentials.

findings.suggested_fix: do not depend on the editable .pth: pass `--app-dir apps/api` to uvicorn and put apps/api on PYTHONPATH in child_env for the worker and bootstrap; make doctor import bean_api with the services' environment. findings.title: PR #14 (unmerged): on macOS the owned-session cleanup raises PermissionError, so every normally finishing scientific job fails and a cancelled job's lifeline guard can outlive it
findings.minimal_input: any baseline on backend/restart-recovery c231be4 on Darwin 25.6.0; or killpg-eperm-repro.py (standard library)
findings.command: python3.11 evaluation/cli.py run --lane offline_real_science --subject http-launch --app-repo <PR #14 checkout> --diagnostic relax_nproc --results <dir>
findings.expected: baselines complete; cancellation leaves no live scientific or guard process
findings.observed: hero and changed-input baselines fail with worker_failed / scientific_attempt_failed; run_bounded with a trivial adapter raises PermissionError at science.py:180 (`os.killpg(process.pid, SIGKILL)` in finally, which catches only ProcessLookupError); cancellation without the barrier leaves 1 live child. Darwin returns EPERM for killpg on a group whose only member is an exited, unreaped leader (standalone repro, CPython 3.11.17 and 3.13.18); Linux returns ESRCH, so Linux validation passed. The exception also skips the rest of the cleanup, including closing the parent lifeline, which is why the guard survives a cancellation. A one-line local diagnostic patch catching PermissionError makes the same lane pass 6/7 (as on main) and cancel/restart with the barrier pass.
findings.impact: merged as is, it would fail all real science on the release Mac once F-MAC-NPROC is fixed (today F-MAC-NPROC masks it) and can leave a process behind after cancellation; Linux CI cannot see it
findings.suggested_fix: treat PermissionError like ProcessLookupError for killpg of the owned session (all such calls), keep join/close of receiver and lifeline in their own finally so one failed signal never skips them, and add a Darwin regression from killpg-eperm-repro.py

findings.minimal_input: commentary_rejection('The checked design selects 8 h with a hard allowance of 0.2 mg/L for this reviewed pair.', [fact]) with fact lacking design_tier/verification/replay/expected_binding, or with any of them negative, or with a known-bad native_replay on the same record
findings.expected: unsupported_claim unless the cited record shows checked_pair_separation, verification valid, replay passed and binding matches (that supported statement must be kept)
findings.observed: main's phrase-list guard returns None (keeps the claim) in all 10 cases; this branch's former positive fixture relied on that and was scientifically invalid (PR #28's reported disagreement)
findings.impact: an explanation could call numerical or unverified evidence a checked design; P2 at the controlled tier, P1 before live narration

findings.title: native_engine_controls gate admitted dirty (and otherwise unqualified) control records
findings.minimal_input: controls.jsonl record naming the tested commit with worktree_dirty: true and every required control passed
findings.expected: a dirty, preview, wrong-interpreter or wrong-engine record cannot satisfy the gate; the newest relevant record decides each control
findings.observed: gates.compute copied worktree_dirty into its per-control map but never enforced it: the gate reported passed (audit reproduction; the end-to-end regression fails with 'passed' != 'blocked' on the pre-fix gates.py). This defect did not by itself make the audited release pass: other gates were not passing at that audit.
findings.fixed_in: control records now carry the imported engine identity (version, repository source digest); the gate admits a control only from its newest run that is clean, executed acceptance of this checkout, CPython 3.11 and the tested engine source; older passes never override newer invalid evidence

check_catalog.note: Finding ids that a check names when it fails. They are not observed findings: an id appears in `findings` only after a check actually failed or was blocked. Every id cited by evaluation/drbean_eval or tests/integration must be a finding or listed here (enforced by evaluation/tests).

F-ANCHOR-RECORD.meaning: authenticated records do not expose the complete replay anchor for a downloaded native packet

F-APPROVAL-REUSE.meaning: an earlier baseline or design approval started work on a different plan

F-CREDENTIAL-READ.meaning: a guarded API/worker process read a present provider credential variable while AI is a placeholder

F-DESIGN-AUTHORITY.meaning: a design was proposed, approved or started without its own separate, current authority

F-DESIGN-JOB.meaning: a design job ended non-completed without a named worker or runtime cause

F-DESIGN-TIER.meaning: a reviewed design request returned an unexpected or unexplained tier

F-EXTERNAL-ATTEMPT.meaning: the egress guard recorded an external connection or a provider client construction

F-FALSE-CHECKED.meaning: checked separation claimed without a strictly positive exact margin, valid verification, passed replay and matching binding

F-FOLLOWUP-BINDING.meaning: a follow-up plan accepted a tampered, substituted or foreign design scope

F-HERO-NO-PAIR.meaning: the hero baseline produced no two distinct fixed candidates (inside and outside the claim) to design on

F-HERO-NO-WITNESS.meaning: the known-positive hero baseline returned no individually compatible strict outside candidate

F-ORPHAN-CANCEL.meaning: a scientific child process is still alive after cancelling its running job

F-RUNTIME-MISSING.meaning: the API reports scientific_runtime_missing: no prepared CPython 3.11 engine was configured for the stack (set DRBEAN_SCIENCE_PYTHON or run scripts/dev/launcher.py setup); see H-CI-ENGINE

F-SCHEMA-DRIFT.meaning: the API now requires request fields the reviewed packet does not define

F-SCIENCE-WORKER.meaning: a run failed with scientific_worker_failed (the bounded scientific child failed)

F-SOURCE-ADMISSION.meaning: a valid synthetic PNG was refused for a reason other than a malformed image

F-SOURCE-BYPASS.meaning: a dataset citing a source asset was accepted without review and materialization

F-STALE-APPROVAL.meaning: an approval for an outdated plan or revision still started work
